items_flat.title_en: OpenAI will end direct model access for SpaceX-owned Cursor on 12 Nov
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 將於 11 月 12 日終止對 SpaceX 旗下 Cursor 的直接模型供應
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it notified SpaceX it will wind down the contract that supplies OpenAI models to Cursor, proposing a 12 November 2026 shutoff—the maximum notice in the change-of-control clause. It will not provide future models, including Astra, citing lack of confidence that SpaceX will stay inside OpenAI’s terms after prior contract and ToS disputes involving Musk companies.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布已通知 SpaceX，將依控制權變更條款給予最長預告期，於 2026 年 11 月 12 日終止向 Cursor 直接供應模型，且不會提供含 Astra 在內的後續模型。理由是基於與馬斯克相關公司過往違約與違反服務條款的經驗，無法確信 SpaceX 會遵守其條款。
items_flat.analysis_en: The cutoff converts a multi-model IDE into a more vertically integrated SpaceX/xAI surface and tests whether change-of-control clauses become standard weapons after lab or platform M&A. Developers keep access until mid-November; what replaces OpenAI inside Cursor after that date is still an operational, not legal, question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉把多模型 IDE 推向更垂直整合的 SpaceX／xAI 產品面，也測試控制權變更條款是否會成為實驗室併購後的標準武器。開發者仍有到 11 月中的緩衝；之後 Cursor 用什麼替代 OpenAI，目前仍是營運問題而非已決法律結果。
items_flat.quote: Today, we notified SpaceX that we intend to wind down our contract providing OpenAI models to Cursor, with a proposed shutoff date of November 12, 2026.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們已通知 SpaceX，打算終止向 Cursor 提供 OpenAI 模型的合約，提議的關閉日期為 2026 年 11 月 12 日。

items_flat.title_en: Sony Music and Warner Chappell sue Anthropic over Claude training data
items_flat.title_zh: Sony Music 與 Warner Chappell 就 Claude 訓練資料起訴 Anthropic
items_flat.summary_en: Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell Music filed suit in the Northern District of California against Anthropic and co-founders Dario Amodei and Benjamin Mann, alleging torrenting, scraping and downloading of copyrighted compositions to train Claude. Plaintiffs seek statutory damages of up to $150,000 per work plus CMI-stripping penalties; Anthropic said it disagrees and will defend itself in court.
items_flat.summary_zh: Sony Music Publishing 與 Warner Chappell 在加州北區聯邦法院起訴 Anthropic 及共同創辦人 Dario Amodei、Benjamin Mann，指控以 BT、爬取與下載受著作權保護的曲目訓練 Claude，並請求每件最高 15 萬美元法定賠償及移除著作權管理資訊的罰則。Anthropic 回應不同意指控，將在法院抗辯。
items_flat.analysis_en: Coming after Anthropic’s earlier author/publisher settlement, the case extends the training-data fight from books into major music catalogs and names founders personally. Statutory maxima imply billion-dollar exposure if thousands of works are proven and willfulness is found; that figure is a ceiling, not an awarded amount.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此案接在 Anthropic 先前與作者／出版社和解之後，把訓練資料爭議從書籍擴到主流音樂目錄，並點名創辦人個人。法定上限在「成千上萬」作品且認定故意時可達數十億美元量級，但那是請求上限，不是已判決金額。
items_flat.quote: We disagree with the publishers’ claims and we intend to defend ourselves robustly in court.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們不同意出版商的主張，並打算在法庭上強力抗辯。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic to replace Claude Code’s 50% weekly-limit promo with a 25% permanent raise on 14 Sep
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic：9 月 14 日起以永久提高 25% 取代 Claude Code 週限額 50% 促銷
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s developer account said that from 14 September it will permanently raise standard weekly Claude Code limits by 25% for Pro, Max, Team and seat-based Enterprise plans, and that the current 50% increase stays until then. A follow-up post stated the new cap is a 17% reduction versus today’s promotional allowance.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 開發者帳號宣布，自 9 月 14 日起，Pro、Max、Team 與座位制 Enterprise 的 Claude Code 標準週限額將永久提高 25%，此前維持現行 50% 加碼。後續貼文說明，相對於今日促銷額度，新上限約減少 17%。
items_flat.analysis_en: The math matters more than the headline: heavy agent users who staffed work against the summer promo will lose capacity unless they buy usage credits. Anthropic flagged unspecified upcoming controls that it says will make usage feel larger; those features are not yet public.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 數字比標題重要：依夏季促銷排班的重度 agent 使用者，若未加買用量額度，實際容量會下降。Anthropic 預告尚未公開的用量可見度與控制功能，宣稱會讓人覺得「用到更多」，但細節未出。
items_flat.quote: Starting September 14, we're permanently raising standard weekly limits in Claude Code by 25% for Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans. Until then, the current 50% increase will be in place.
items_flat.quote_zh: 自 9 月 14 日起，我們將為 Pro、Max、Team 與座位制 Enterprise 方案永久提高 Claude Code 標準週限額 25%。在此之前，現行 50% 加碼仍有效。

items_flat.title_en: Official DALL·E GPT retires in ChatGPT; image gen moves to ChatGPT Images
items_flat.title_zh: 官方 DALL·E GPT 今日自 ChatGPT 下架，生圖改走 ChatGPT Images
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI’s ChatGPT release notes say the official DALL·E GPT is retired on 30 August 2026 and users should download images they want to keep. Image generation continues via ChatGPT Images; user-created GPTs with image generation enabled are not affected.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI ChatGPT 更新說明寫明，官方 DALL·E GPT 於 2026 年 8 月 30 日退役，使用者應先下載想保留的圖片。生圖改由 ChatGPT Images 提供；已開啟生圖的使用者自建 GPT 不受影響。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a product-surface sunset, not an end to OpenAI image models. The practical uncertainty is what happens to unsaved DALL·E GPT outputs after today; OpenAI has not published a retention window beyond the download warning.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是產品入口下架，不是 OpenAI 圖像模型停產。未下載的 DALL·E GPT 產出今日之後如何保存，官方除「請先下載」外未另給保留期限。
items_flat.quote: On August 30, 2026, we’re retiring the official DALL·E GPT in ChatGPT. We encourage you to download any images you want to keep before then.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們將於 2026 年 8 月 30 日退役 ChatGPT 中的官方 DALL·E GPT。請在此之前下載任何想保留的圖片。

brief_en: Quiet Sunday: OpenAI’s DALL·E GPT retires today as image gen stays in ChatGPT Images. The Cursor/SpaceX model cutoff, Sony–Warner’s music suit against Anthropic, and Claude Code’s Sept 14 limit reset remain the live stories—no new flagship models shipped.
brief_zh: 週日偏靜：OpenAI 官方 DALL·E GPT 今日下架，生圖改走 ChatGPT Images。Cursor／SpaceX 模型斷供、Sony／Warner 告 Anthropic、Claude Code 9/14 額度調整仍是主線，無新旗艦模型發布。
